## 8c73e339d80e

**Generated teaching defect: rotation codes can be completely invisible.**
The sampler permits a 2x2 square base, but `self_check` does not require the
base to have a nontrivial rotation orbit. At seed 0/sample index 6 (ordinary
band), it emitted a square base with marker codes `[9,9,6]`; all are nonidentity
codes, yet every rotation of the square is identical. The input passes
`self_check` and belongs to the documented generator domain. A rival that
ignores every code and always stamps the unrotated base exactly matches the
selected Racket output (`RULE_HASH d2185c0081d9`) on this case. Evidence:
`checks/audit/8c73e339d80e/input.json`, `rival-ignore-codes.json`,
`racket.json`, `comparison.json`, and `metadata.json`.

This does not prove an assembled four-demo lesson is ambiguous, but it is a
concrete generated pair that contributes no evidence for the code-to-rotation
mapping and can support an ignore-code shortcut. The target also reproduces the
same broad contract defects as the other audit: missing rule pin, dead texture
axes, silent unknown overrides, 14,073+ override findings, and 28,380
undeclared multi-axis rejections. Those checker reports are under
`checks/audit-8c73e339d80e-*`; no audit-target source was changed.

triage.reason: Accepted as source-bound reviewer-reported findings. d9829b956366: pin/lint/texture/override contract failures; border-only shortcut already refuted by sampled border-touching component. 8c73e339d80e: symmetric square hides transformation in one pair, not proof of full-lesson ambiguity; broad override/contract findings retained. No audited source changed.
